_meta.description: Score each row's fit to a target profile with ATTR_PROFILE_SIMILARITY on experiment.pulse, averaged per treatment arm. The named vector spend (revenue_before, revenue; labels before / after) declares kind scale, so match_shape takes the scale similarity default, correlation (reported in predict's defaults_applied) — with two members it is +1 or -1, the direction of the change. match_cosine names cosine against a label map {after, before}, matched BY LABEL (never by position): cosine on a kind scale vector is a poor fit, so the run carries a PULSE_VECTOR_METRIC_UNSUITED warning naming the correlation default. A reference whose labels are not the vector's is refused at predict with PULSE_VECTOR_REFERENCE_MISMATCH. Row-local, single pass and streamable; the weight is irrelevant. An embedder's Extensions.ReferenceVectors tables are read with reference {table, key} or {table, key_field}.
_meta.name: attr_profile_similarity
